help.intro: Ibisubizo bigufi ku byo abantu batubaza cyane. Niba icyawe kitarimo, itsinda risubiza mu munsi umwe w'akazi.

how-to-book.title: Uko gufata bikorwa
how-to-book.body:
Hitamo amatariki, urebe igiciro, unyure mu ntambwe enye ngufi: amakuru yawe, ibyongerwaho, amabwiriza, hanyuma kwishyura.

Tubika amatariki mu minota {holdMinutes} mu gihe wishyura. Ubwishyu bumaze kugenda, uhabwa nimero itangirwa na HL- n'icyemezo kuri imeyili no kuri konti yawe.

ways-to-pay.title: Uburyo bwo kwishyura
ways-to-pay.body:
Ushobora kwishyura ukoresheje ikarita (Visa cyangwa Mastercard) cyangwa Mobile Money (MTN cyangwa Airtel). Ibiciro bishyirwa mu mafaranga y'u Rwanda; andi mafaranga yerekanwa ku gaciro k'uyu munsi.

Ku kuhaba igihe kirekire, ushobora kwishyura igice ubu n'ikindi hafi y'igihe cyo kuhagera.

fees.title: Ibiri mu giciro
fees.body:
Igiciro ubona mu kwishyura ni cyo wishyura. Kirimo amajoro, amafaranga y'isuku RWF {cleaning} ku kuhaba, n'amafaranga ya serivisi angana na {feePercent}% y'amajoro.

Nta kindi cyongerwaho ku musozo.

escrow.title: Impamvu ubwishyu bumwe bubikwa
escrow.body:
Ku kuhaba gufite agaciro ka RWF {escrowFrom} cyangwa arenga, tubika ubwishyu bwawe kugeza winjiye. Inzu yishyurwa ari uko uri imbere kandi imeze uko yavuzwe.

Niba itameze uko, tubwire mu munsi wa mbere tukabikosora cyangwa tukagusubiza amafaranga.

cancel-stay.title: Guhagarika kuhaba
cancel-stay.body:
Uhagaritse iminsi {stayDays} mbere yo kuhagera, usubizwa byose.

Nyuma yaho kugeza ku munsi ubanziriza, usubizwa kimwe cya kabiri cy'amajoro, n'amafaranga y'isuku n'ibyongerwaho. Ku munsi wo kuhagera nta gusubizwa.

cancel-car-day.title: Guhagarika imodoka cyangwa urugendo
cancel-car-day.body:
Imodoka ishobora guhagarikwa ugasubizwa byose kugeza iminsi {carDays} mbere yo kuyifata. Nyuma yaho, hafatwa umunsi umwe w'ubukode.

Urugendo rushobora guhagarikwa ugasubizwa byose kugeza iminsi {dayDays} mbere. Impushya za pariki zaguzwe mu izina ryawe ntizigurishwa, igice cyazo kirafatwa.

change-dates.title: Guhindura amatariki
change-dates.body:
Fungura ibyo wafashe kuri konti yawe uhitemo amatariki mashya. Ubona igiciro gishya n'itandukaniro mbere yo kwemeza.

Niba amatariki mashya ahenduka, itandukaniro rirakugarukira; niba ahenze, wishyura itandukaniro. Amatariki ahindurwa gusa mbere y'uko ibyo wafashe bitangira.

refund-timing.title: Igihe amafaranga asubizwa agera
refund-timing.body: Twohereza ibisubizwa uwo munsi. Mobile Money igaragara mu minota mike; amakarita afata iminsi 5 kugeza 10 y'akazi, bitewe na banki yawe.

check-in.title: Kwinjira
check-in.body:
Kwinjira ni guhera saa {checkIn}. Aderesi, kode y'urugi na wi-fi bikugeraho amasaha 48 mbere, mu byo wafashe no mu butumwa, ntabwo mbere yaho.

Uzagera utinze? Andika isaha yawe mu byo wafashe, hazaba umuntu, cyangwa kode y'agasanduku k'imfunguzo izakora igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

something-wrong.title: Hari ikibazo uri mu nzu
something-wrong.body:
Kimenyekanishe uhereye ku byo wafashe: hitamo icyo ari cyo n'uko cyihutirwa. Icyihutirwa (nta muriro, nta mazi, urugi) kigera ku itsinda ako kanya, ku manywa no nijoro.

Ushobora no guhamagara umurongo w'ubutabazi uri ku rupapuro rwo kutwandikira.

extras.title: Kwakirwa ku kibuga cy'indege, kwinjira kare n'ibindi byongerwaho
extras.body:
Ongeraho ibyongerwaho mu gufata, cyangwa nyuma uhereye ku byo wafashe. Itsinda ritegura buri kimwe rikakwemeza mu butumwa.

Bisubizwa byose niba uhagaritse mbere yo kuhagera.

verified.title: Icyo "byagenzuwe" bivuze
verified.body:
Umuntu wo mu itsinda ryacu yageze muri buri nzu, yatwaye buri modoka kandi yakoze buri rugendo dutanga, akurikije urutonde rw'igenzura, akanabifotora ubwe.

Urupapuro rwerekana uwabigenzuye n'igihe.

renting-how.title: Uko gukodesha bikorwa
renting-how.body:
Gukodesha ni amezi 12 cyangwa 24, bitangira ku itariki ya 1 y'ukwezi. Usaba utanga amakuru make n'indangamuntu; itsinda risubiza mu minsi ibiri y'akazi.

Wishyura ukwezi kwa mbere n'ingwate kugira ngo winjire, hanyuma ubukode buri kwezi.

renting-deposit.title: Ingwate
renting-deposit.body:
Ingwate ibikwa igihe cyose cy'ubukode igasubizwa nyuma yo kuvamo, inzu imaze kugenzurwa ugereranyije n'uko wayakiriye.

Niba hari amafaranga agumanywe kubera gusana, ubwirwa icyo ari cyo n'impamvu, mu nyandiko, mbere y'uko ibisigaye byoherezwa.

renting-repairs.title: Gusana uri gukodesha
renting-repairs.body:
Menyekanisha ibikeneye gusanwa uhereye ku rupapuro rw'ubukode. Ibyihutirwa (amazi, umuriro, umutekano) birebwa uwo munsi; ibindi bitegurwa nawe.

Ntuzigera wishyuzwa ibyangiritse kubera gukoresha inzu bisanzwe.

renting-moving-out.title: Kuvamo
renting-moving-out.body: Tubwire itariki yo kuvamo nibura ukwezi mbere. Dushyiraho igenzura uwo munsi, tugereranya inzu n'uko wayakiriye, tugasubiza ingwate.

car-with-driver.title: Imodoka n'umushoferi
car-with-driver.body:
Umushoferi ahurira nawe aho uvuze, azi imihanda kandi agutegereza. Ibiryo bye na lisansi biri mu giciro.

Ubona izina rye mu byo wafashe mbere y'umunsi.

car-self-drive.title: Kwitwarira
car-self-drive.body:
Ukeneye uruhushya rwo gutwara rumaze nibura imyaka ibiri. Rushyireho mu gufata; itsinda rirarugenzura mbere yo gufata imodoka.

Abanditswe nk'abashoferi mu byo wafashe ni bo bonyine batwara.

car-pickup.title: Gufata no gusubiza imodoka
car-pickup.body: Gufata imodoka ni aho ibyo wafashe bivuga, akenshi ku kibuga cy'indege. Imodoka yerekanwa n'amafoto y'ibimenyetso bisanzweho, igasubizwa ifite lisansi ingana n'iyo yagiye ifite.

car-insurance.title: Ubwishingizi
car-insurance.body: Buri modoka ifite ubwishingizi bw'undi muntu. Ubwishingizi bwuzuye ni icyongerwaho ushobora gushyiraho mu gufata, kigabanya ibyo wishyura imodoka yangiritse.

day-what-to-bring.title: Ibyo kuzana
day-what-to-bring.body:
Buri rugendo rwerekana ibyo kuzana ku rupapuro rwarwo: akenshi amazi, inkweto zigenda, n'umwenda ushyushye wo ku misozi.

Umuyobozi akubwira aho muhurira mu byo wafashe.

day-permits.title: Impushya za pariki
day-permits.body:
Ingendo zimwe zikenera uruhushya rwa pariki mu izina rya buri muntu, ni yo mpamvu amazina na nimero za pasiporo bisabwa mu gufata.

Impushya ntizigurishwa, igice cyazo ntigisubizwa uhagaritse.

day-group.title: Ingano y'itsinda n'imyaka
day-group.body: Buri rugendo rwerekana itsinda rinini n'imyaka mike yemewe. Gufata ntibikwemerera kongeramo abantu barenze imyanya.

day-weather.title: Ikirere kibaye kibi
day-weather.body: Ingendo zikomeza mu mvura keretse habaye akaga. Umuyobozi cyangwa pariki biruhagaritse, uhitamo undi munsi cyangwa ugasubizwa byose.

contact.title: Twandikire
contact.intro: Andikira itsinda, cyangwa utugereho kuri WhatsApp cyangwa kuri telefoni. Dusubiza mu munsi umwe w'akazi, ako kanya ku byihutirwa uri mu nzu.
contact.badReference: Iyi nimero ntiri mu byo wafashe. Yigenzure, cyangwa usige ubusa.
contact.sentBody: Itsinda rizagusubiza mu munsi umwe w'akazi.
contact.signInFirst: Injira kugira ngo tugusubize kandi tubone ibyo wafashe.
contact.hours: Buri munsi, saa moya za mu gitondo kugeza saa yine z'ijoro
contact.emergencyBody: Igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, ku manywa no nijoro, ku kintu cyihutirwa mu nzu.

legal.draft: Inyandiko y'agateganyo yo gusuzumwa. Inyandiko ya nyuma izatangwa n'abanyamategeko bacu mbere yo gutangiza.

terms.title: Amategeko yo gukoresha
terms.intro: Aya mategeko areba gufata amazu, imodoka n'ingendo kuri HomeLink Africa Ltd mu Rwanda.

who.title: Abo turi bo
who.body: HomeLink Africa Ltd yakira buri nzu itanga kandi itegura buri modoka n'urugendo hamwe n'abashoferi n'abayobozi yagenzuye. Ufata binyuze kuri twe, si kuri nyir'inzu.

booking.title: Gufata
booking.body: Gufata byemezwa iyo ubwishyu bugenze ugahabwa nimero. Amabwiriza y'inzu, imodoka cyangwa urugendo ni kimwe mu bigize ibyo wafashe, kandi yerekanwa mbere yo kwishyura.

paying.title: Kwishyura
paying.body: Ibiciro biri mu mafaranga y'u Rwanda kandi birimo amafaranga yose: amajoro, isuku ya RWF {cleaning} ku kuhaba na serivisi ya {feePercent}%. Ubwishyu bwa RWF {escrowFrom} cyangwa burenga ku kuhaba bubikwa kugeza winjiye.

verified.title: Icyo dusezeranya
verified.body: Ibyo dutanga byose byagenzuwe imbonankubone. Niba inzu, imodoka cyangwa urugendo bitameze uko byavuzwe, tubwire mu munsi tukabikosora cyangwa tukagusubiza amafaranga.

conduct.title: Uruhare rwawe
conduct.body: Kurikiza amabwiriza y'inzu, uyisige uko wayisanze, kandi utubwire ibyangiritse. Abanditswe mu byo wafashe gusa ni bo bahaba, batwara cyangwa bajyamo.

liability.title: Inshingano
liability.body: Dufite inshingano ku byo dusezeranya haruguru. Ntitubazwa igihombo kirenze igiciro cy'ibyo wafashe, keretse itegeko rivuze ukundi.

privacy.title: Itangazo ry'ubuzima bwite
privacy.intro: Ibyo tubika kuri wowe, impamvu, n'ibyo ushobora kudusaba kubikoraho.

what.title: Ibyo tubika
what.body: Izina n'aho tukubona, ibyo wafashe n'ubwishyu bwawe, ubutumwa n'itsinda, n'indangamuntu iyo gukodesha cyangwa imodoka biyikeneye. Amafoto akurwaho aho yafatiwe kuri telefoni yawe mbere yo koherezwa.

why.title: Impamvu
why.body: Gukora no gukurikirana ibyo wafashe, kurinda amazu n'abantu, no kubahiriza amategeko y'ubwishyu n'ubukode. Ntitugurisha amakuru yawe.

who.title: Abayabona
who.body: Itsinda rikurikirana ibyo wafashe, umushoferi cyangwa umuyobozi ubirimo (ibyo akeneye gusa), n'abatanga serivisi zo kwishyura. Ntitujya tubika nimero z'amakarita.

keep.title: Igihe tuyabika
keep.body: Inyemezabwishyu igihe itegeko ry'imisoro risaba. Amafoto y'indangamuntu asibwa nyuma y'iminsi 30 agenzuwe. Ibindi byose bisibwa ufunze konti.

rights.title: Uburenganzira bwawe
rights.body: Ushobora gukuramo kopi y'amakuru yawe cyangwa gufunga konti uhereye ku igenamiterere, no kudusaba gukosora ibitari byo.

contact.title: Ibibazo
contact.body: Twandikire uhereye ku rupapuro rwo kutwandikira, ushinzwe amakuru azagusubiza.

cancellation.title: Amabwiriza yo guhagarika
cancellation.intro: Ibyo usubizwa uhagaritse, bitewe n'ubwoko bw'ibyo wafashe. Ibyo wafashe bihora byerekana amafaranga nyayo mbere yo kwemeza.

stays.title: Amacumbi
stays.body:
Kugeza iminsi {stayDays} mbere yo kuhagera: usubizwa byose.

Nyuma yaho kugeza ku munsi ubanziriza: kimwe cya kabiri cy'amajoro, n'isuku n'ibyongerwaho byose. Ku munsi wo kuhagera: nta gusubizwa.

renting.title: Gukodesha
renting.body: Mbere yo kwinjira, ukwezi kwa mbere n'ingwate bisubizwa byose uhagaritse nibura iminsi 30 mbere. Umaze kwinjira, amasezerano y'ubukode agaragaza uko wava mbere.

cars.title: Imodoka
cars.body: Kugeza iminsi {carDays} mbere yo gufata: usubizwa byose. Nyuma yaho, umunsi umwe w'ubukode urafatwa, ibisigaye bigasubizwa.

days.title: Ingendo
days.body: Kugeza iminsi {dayDays} mbere: usubizwa byose. Nyuma yaho, nta gusubizwa. Impushya za pariki zaguzwe mu izina ryawe ntizijya zisubizwa, kuko zitagurishwa.

ours.title: Turamutse duhagaritse
ours.body: Turamutse duhagaritse, usubizwa byose ako kanya, kandi itsinda rikaguha ikindi kingana cyangwa kiruta niba gihari.

how.title: Uko uhagarika
how.body: Fungura ibyo wafashe kuri konti yawe uhitemo Hagarika. Ubona ibisubizwa mbere yo kwemeza, kandi amafaranga yoherezwa uwo munsi.

reviews.title: {score} ku bitekerezo {count}
reviews.new: Ni bishya kuri HomeLink: ibitekerezo {count} kugeza ubu. Twerekana amanota abashyitsi batatu bamaze kuhaba, kugira ngo igitekerezo kimwe kitavuga ahantu hose.
